description: Shared Renovate preset for bjorntirsen repositories

packageRules.description: Group stable non-major updates into one weekly PR and automerge it when CI passes. 0.x minors are excluded: their minor bumps are breaking by semver convention.
0.x patches are non-breaking, so they join the weekly group and automerge too

0.x build/format tooling whose minors CI fully exercises (format:check, build). Their history is consistently green, so they join the weekly group instead of waiting for a manual merge. Add a tool here only when CI would catch a breaking minor.
Pinning ships no new code, and digests carry no release timestamp, so the release-age gate would hold pin PRs pending forever

GitHub Action majors are mostly runtime bumps and the PR's own CI runs them, so automerge on green. Only `uses:` refs (depType action): tool versions passed via `with:` (node-version, java-version) are runtime choices, not action upgrades. Actions that only run in push-to-master deploy jobs never run in PR CI, so their majors stay manual.
actions/setup-node is sometimes referenced by full semver tag; loose versioning keeps Renovate from misreading it

Node runtime majors (.nvmrc, engines, Dockerfile, CI) and @types/node move together and only on purpose. Approve from the Dependency Dashboard when migrating to the next LTS. actions/node-versions is how Renovate names the setup-node `node-version` input.
vitest and its plugins must share a major version
Drizzle ORM and kit must move together. Both are 0.x, so minors are breaking and stay manual; patches still ride the weekly group.
